## 3. shared.pipeline.unknown_creation_methods — title pipeline-creation methods at vtable slots 0x1c8 and 0x218 (title+0x2477578, title+0x24800d5) return E_NOTIMPL

- owner / chain / hop: shared / command / shared D3D12.X -> host D3D12 (before seam A)
- freq: 18,432 (log); used=yes; status=gap
- Xbox hardware / driver does: Console D3D12 has two pipeline-creation methods the PC API lacks.
- deviation: Title goes without those pipelines silently (what they draw is unknown): whole draws and dispatches missing, maybe visible as absent geometry, or the engine uses a fallback (not proven).
- restore_plan (how to break through): Decode the logged descriptions (first words point at stream tokens: the dump in the log) and implement the two methods through CreatePipelineState from a stream; feasibility medium. This is the largest known unsupported call count in the shared layer.
- tests: device::tests missing() asserts E_NOTIMPL; no test for the real methods
- notes: The log prints 16 words of description per call; the dumps are in research/game-runs/20261127-*/stderr.log. Metal owner sees the draws only if they reach the translator. | G9 conclusion (mac/notimpl-pso a4566985, 2026-11-28; docs/mac/PATCHES.md G9): slots 0x1c8 (graphics) and 0x218 (compute) are the title's OWN PSO-cache hit paths. 0x1c8 is called per entry of the cache object (filled from a file at start); a hit is stored by the first shader's key, a miss is skipped, and a graphics job that finds no PSO in that table builds a stream and calls 0x2b0. 0x218 is called once per compute job; when it returns 0 the job calls 0x1f0 with the compute DXBC container it already loaded. So E_NOTIMPL = cache miss: the title falls back to 0x2b0 / 0x1f0 (both implemented in the shared layer). The earlier reading 'the title skips those draws' has no static evidence and the fallback path contradicts it; this note supersedes the deviation and restore_plan above; the real cost is one more per-container creation. 0x218 is implemented (VICTORY_MAC_PSO_X=1: FSPX record -> container -> compute_from_container) but OFF by default: the FSPX route is unproven on the title's own compute shaders and a translation failure only shows at first dispatch, when no fallback is left; any unreadable record returns E_NOTIMPL as before. 0x1c8 is deliberately left E_NOTIMPL (record layout not decodable offline; value would only be saving the 0x2b0 fallback). A/B to turn 0x218 on by default (drop-ab B0 vs B1) is still to run.

## 5. S-G-002 — pixel programs that read per-vertex attributes / compute their own barycentrics (P0/P10/P20) -> dx.op.attributeAtVertex

- owner / chain / hop: shared / shader / 5 MSC 4.0.3 (back/src/msc)
- freq: 4,852 (census:2026-11-27); used=yes; status=gap
- Xbox hardware / driver does: RDNA2 interpolates in LDS: a pixel program can read P0/P10/P20 (parameter at each vertex) and compute any interpolation (flat, provoking vertex, custom)
- deviation: MSC 4.0.3 refuses dx.op.attributeAtVertex.f32 (MSC manual: "GetAttributeAtVertex not supported"; 4852 of 12067 Ps containers = 40%; 330 CREATE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE refusals in the 370 s run). Every pipeline with such a pixel shader is not created, its draws are dropped: the largest single block of missing geometry/materials seen in the run. (Another hand is working on this in metal-livetr.) Run r6: 330 refusals, 103 pipelines, 102 mesh (C-B-011).
- restore_plan (how to break through): Four routes under investigation: MSC switch / Metal-native per-vertex fragment inputs / DXIL rewrite before MSC / translator switch; fidelity first (the lead's list, 2026-11-27). One candidate for the translator route: SV_Barycentrics (accepted, linear only, MSC manual) plus the three vertex values as plain inputs supplied per-vertex from the vertex/mesh stage (flat-pull via a vertex-pulling stage-in buffer indexed by SV_PrimitiveID*3+vertex) and manual interpolation in the pixel shader. Fidelity: exact for linear interpolation; perspective-correct weights come from SV_Barycentrics (perspective) and centroid is refused by MSC (feature table). Feasibility 可行 for non-centroid; 待验证 for centroid/sample modes. Sources: MSC UserManual.md "Feature support matrix" (metal-irconverter 4.0.3), 2026-11-27; census/mac-side.md.
- tests: —
- notes: code: emit/lower.rs per_vertex; census.json failures; mac-side.md. Same cause 330x in the run.

## 6. C-F-027 — depth bounds test (OMSetDepthBounds + PSO depth_bounds flag)

- owner / chain / hop: metal / command / 3 front core (d3d12.dll/dxgi.dll)
- freq: 4,807 (callstats:20261127-221938-map); used=yes; status=gap
- Xbox hardware / driver does: the depth block rejects fragments whose stored depth is outside [min,max] (used for light volumes / shadows)
- deviation: accepted and ignored: 4807 calls in 370 s (the only method the front reports as "accepted, no effect"). Fragments that should be culled are shaded: wrong lighting/shadows where the title relies on it; PSO depth_bounds flag was 0 in all 1340 PSOs of the run (title uses the command with the flag off, so the effect may be nil).
- restore_plan (how to break through): Metal has no depth bounds test (no symbol in Metal.framework headers, grep depthBounds/conservative, SDK 27.2, 2026-11-27). Emulate in the pixel shader: read the stored depth through a depth-attachment sampled copy or a tile/imageblock load (MTL4TileRenderPipeline.h) and discard when outside bounds; needs a PSO variant keyed by the flag and a per-draw uniform. Feasibility 待验证; check first whether the flag is ever set (0 of 1340 PSOs).
- tests: —
- notes: code: front/src/shell (note_notimpl "OMSetDepthBounds"), notimpl.log. freq source: callstats and summary.txt of the run.

## 9. shared.rt.bvh_build — dispatches of the title's ray-tracing structure builder (XboxBvhBuilder.dll, 52 compute pipelines on the new Metal base: unpack of shipped static BVHs, build/refit of dynamic ones, CopyForBVHUpdate): dropped unless VICTORY_BVH_BUILDER=1 and all builder pipelines have host pipelines (pipeline.rs:351 builder_runs; draw.rs:3150 dispatch)

- owner / chain / hop: shared / command / shared D3D12.X -> host D3D12 (before seam A)
- freq: 1,168 (log:logs/run-2026-11-27b/b3-diag-stacks/stderr.log:20045-37719 (8 five-second windows 14:07:09-14:08:01Z, 667-1712 dispatches/frame, mean 1168; reason 'a stage of the ray-tracing structure builder, which is off'); research/world-drops/20261127-2301/cold/stderr.log:4127-9153 (129-1475)); used=yes; status=unproven
- Xbox hardware / driver does: the console GPU builder library builds and refits the BVH (64-byte AMD nodes) on the GPU every frame; static world structures ship packed and are unpacked in place by builder programs (DecompressHeader, Box32/Box16Rehydration, LeafRehydration)
- deviation: default OFF on every launcher (tools/mac/run.sh, tools/macos/victory.sh, tools/metal/run.sh set no RT variable). Every builder stage is dropped (counted in 'dropped ... without a host pipeline'): no dynamic BVH is built, no static BVH rehydrated; trace programs find nothing (docs/fork-ray-tracing.md:140 'every ray misses'). Deliberate, 3 legitimate reasons: (1) all-or-none safety: a partly running builder wrote garbage bounds into title memory and killed the title (pipeline.rs:255-281, run 98); (2) cost ~40 ms/frame on 7900XTX (fork doc:3-7); (3) open correctness gaps: dynamic structures overlap (8/65 good in light-10, 48/275 in light-15, doc:109-117), a replay capture with the builder on hangs the card (doc:126). Cold cache + BUILDER=1 passed the title's 30 s GPU watchdog (ec648b34 message); fixed by mac: cherry-pick of ec648b34 (builder pipelines queued at creation, a dispatch skips while one is being made; VICTORY_BVH_BUILDER_SYNC=1 restores the old behaviour) - unit tests only, 待运行验证 (cold-cache run with VICTORY_BVH_BUILDER=1: first frame must stay under 30 s).
- restore_plan (how to break through): 1) one run of mac/livetr with VICTORY_BVH_BUILDER=1 VICTORY_BVH_QUARANTINE=1 to read 'stays off ... which=[hashes]' or 'runs' (0.5 d + a game run, needs the user's go); 2) DONE in code 2026-11-28: ec648b34 (builder pipelines queued at creation, not made on the recording thread) cherry-picked from the Windows line (fix/sun-clamp, gpu/cf-*), 待运行验证 (cold-cache run); 3) title memory by address (memory.rs) on D3DMetal under Wine+Rosetta (3-6 d, unknown); 4) lift quarantine, compare structures with a CPU build by bvh.rs node rules (3-5 d). Total 7-12 person-days. The 3 wave64 first-lane scan programs no longer block: on the new Metal base XboxBvhBuilder translates 52/52 and builds its pipelines (Metal backend owner, 2026-11-28), so the earlier step 3 (1-5 d, total 8-17) is gone. Queue position: after the world geometry is drawn (the Metal backend already draws 3D world frames, 7 of the first 15 corpora, w300 = prison interior, see research/captures/INDEX.md; mesh/GS host gaps dominate the visible loss). Fidelity path = run the title's own builder + traversal, not the Metal RT API.
- tests: victory-gpu pipeline::builder_verdict_tests (3: all made / being made skips without turning off / one that cannot be made turns it off); builder_runs and the dispatch gating themselves still have no test
- notes: Gate introduced by fxceless 578d459c (commit date 2026-11-24), kept by the user's Windows line (scripts/play.ps1:26, only with -RayTracing). On the OLD base (origin/main, upstream #481/#2118) the builder is ON whenever all its pipelines are made (pipeline/builder.rs, no switch): different semantics, do not mix. OLD Metal base: 50/53 made (3 refused for first-lane; research/game-runs/*-metal, e.g. 20261127-205345-metal stderr 'made=50 refused=3'). NEW Metal base: 52/52 (earlier drafts counted 53 on the old base; the difference between 53 and 52 is not reconciled here). | 2026-11-28: status gap -> unproven only for the cold-cache making step: ec648b34 is in mac/livetr as a mac: cherry-pick (source Windows fix/sun-clamp), 3 unit tests, no run yet (待运行验证). The builder stays default OFF (disposition stubbed): correctness gaps (3) and steps 1, 3, 4 above are open.

## 20. mac.loader.clwb_nop — clwb write-back loops replaced by NOPs (only if exactly 8 loops are found)

- owner / chain / hop: mac / command / loader patch L4 (clwb.rs)
- freq: 8 (log); used=yes; status=proven
- Xbox hardware / driver does: CLWB pushes dirty lines to memory so non-coherent consumers (GPU, DMA) see CPU writes.
- deviation: Write-back dropped. Safe on this path because all title memory is read by our own CPU code (copies for the GPU: unified memory, CPU-coherent). Would break if the GPU read title memory without a CPU copy (zero-copy) and CPU caches were not coherent.

## 43. S-I-003 — scalar mode registers: s_denorm_mode, s_round_mode (per-wave float mode switched in the program)

- owner / chain / hop: shared / shader / 2 IR build + structure (ir.rs, structure.rs, io.rs, spill.rs)
- freq: 0 (census-opcodes); used=no; status=unproven
- Xbox hardware / driver does: SIMD float mode register: denorm flush on/off and round mode per instruction class, set at program start and by s_denorm_mode/s_round_mode
- deviation: ir.rs:1410-1411 accepts both as having no register effects; whether the lowering applies the new mode to following float ops is 待核实 (grep in emit/lower.rs finds no `s_denorm_mode` handler). MSC also does not support denorm mode (MSC UserManual SM6.2 "denorm mode: No, no error detected"), so a title that switches to flush-to-zero gets IEEE denormals instead: tiny float differences, rarely visible.
- restore_plan (how to break through): Emit explicit flush: `x = abs(x) < smallest_normal ? copysign(0,x) : x` around affected ops where the program mode is FTZ (translator-side, exact); round mode RTZ via explicit f32 arithmetic emulation 待验证. Sources: MSC UserManual.md "Feature support matrix" (metal-irconverter 4.0.3), 2026-11-27.
- tests: —
- notes: code: crates/victory-shader/src/ir.rs:1410; emit/lower.rs float rules ~258, 3915-4036. Census (opcodes, 2026-11-27): s_denorm_mode 0 and s_round_mode 0 of 26177 programs. The package sets the float mode with s_setreg instead: s_setreg_imm32_b32 hwreg(MODE bits 3:2, the double/half round mode) in 7140 programs (=3 round toward zero: 4752 programs; =0 nearest-even: 2388), plus hwreg 20/21 writes in 12235 programs and 10 s_setreg_b32 of hwreg 25; whether the translator applies the MODE round bits to f16/f64 ops: 待核实 (emit/lower.rs:5691 accepts s_setreg as no-op). research/census/opcodes.md "s_setreg targets".

- freq: not measured (unknown); used=yes; status=proven

- deviation: Whole-block copies for every submission instead of only written pages: 129 GB/frame estimated once the world streams (masked.rs header, #50); in logs the opening scene copies 0.1-3.1 MB/frame with tracking off.
- restore_plan (how to break through): Make tracking safe so it can be on: needs every faulting instruction class resumable (masked stores L1 + vcvtps2ph L1, our asm G6, SuspendThread H1, overlapped ReadFile A7); then default on. Alternative without faults: GPU reads title pages in place (no copy) which needs coherent shared mapping (mach_vm_remap, see mac.hle.zero_copy_alias).
- tests: mac::rosetta::tests::the_variable_decides_and_tests_track (native + Wine: pass)
- notes: Decision proven by test; its cost is measured in logs. 0x140456fe2 hang (tracking on) was in victory.exe safecopy (G6).

Corpus captures (research/captures/INDEX.md) all ran with the watchdog off, so they are non-fidelity. | 2026-11-28: one cause of a >30 s frame is fixed in code: cold-cache BVH builder pipelines were made on the recording thread at the first builder dispatch (title died at +0x23cf683 about 77 s after start, 2026-11-26 run with VICTORY_BVH_BUILDER=1). ec648b34 (source: Windows fix/sun-clamp, gpu/cf-*) queues them at creation and skips the dispatch while one is being made; mac: cherry-pick, unit tests only, 待运行验证 (cold-cache run).
